License

#

Card Hand Toolkit is distributed through the Unity Asset Store and is licensed under the Standard Unity Asset Store EULA, found in Appendix 1 of the Asset Store Terms of Service and EULA.

The package contains no third-party components with their own licenses.

The sample card illustrations, card back and game background were generated using ChatGPT. The card illustrations were substantially edited by the author, including removing large portions of the generated images and correcting colours. The card frames and 3D card model were created by the author.

The code was developed with assistance from Codex and Claude Code.
